title: CASS Higher Degree by Research Internship
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must be enrolled in an MPhil or PhD program offered by the College of Arts and Social Sciences and meet the eligibility criteria for internship placements, which include an agreement with the host institution that has also been approved by the relevant College Authorities. You will need to seek permission prior to enroling in this course. Please refer to the link in the "Other Information" section for details.
